list_child.name: lst_decl
list_child.desc: This tool retrieves the complete list of customs declarations currently on file with the brokerage. It is typically used before drilling into an individual record.

get_child.name: get_decl
get_child.desc: This tool fetches a single customs declaration record using its unique identifier. Use it once a specific declaration id is already known.

list_parent.name: lst_imp
list_parent.desc: This tool returns every importer account registered with the brokerage, including those with no open declarations. It supports downstream lookups by importer name.

get_parent.name: get_imp
get_parent.desc: This tool fetches a single importer account by its unique identifier, returning the importer's registered details.

delete_child.name: del_decl
delete_child.desc: This tool permanently deletes a customs declaration record from the brokerage's system. The action cannot be undone, so it should be used with care.

set_enum.name: set_decl_st
set_enum.desc: This tool changes the clearance state of a customs declaration, moving it between pending, held, released, and seized. It should be used whenever a declaration's clearance status changes.

set_bool.name: flag_hold
set_bool.desc: This tool places a customs hold on a declaration, preventing it from clearing until the hold is lifted. It is commonly used when a shipment requires further review.

set_ref.name: mv_decl
set_ref.desc: This tool reassigns a customs declaration from one importer account to another. It is useful when a declaration was filed under the wrong importer of record.

send.name: ntfy_imp
send.desc: This tool sends a notification message to an importer regarding their account or a specific declaration. It is the standard way the brokerage communicates status changes.
